arxiv-2010-05738.title: Using Type Information to Improve Entity Coreference Resolution
arxiv-2010-05738.creator: Sopan Khosla, Carolyn Rose
arxiv-2010-05738.description: Abstract Coreference resolution (CR) is an essential part of discourse analysis. Most recently, neural approaches have been proposed to improve over SOTA models from earlier paradigms. So far none of the published neural models leverage external semantic knowledge such as type information.

arxiv-2102-04737.title: Federated Learning with Local Differential Privacy: Trade-offs between Privacy, Utility, and Communication
arxiv-2102-04737.creator: Muah Kim, Onur Günlü, Rafael F. Schaefer
arxiv-2102-04737.description: Abstract Federated learning (FL) allows to train a massive amount of data privately due to its decentralized structure. Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is commonly used for FL due to its good empirical performance, but sensitive user information can still be inferred from weight updates shared during FL iterations.

arxiv-2104-13689.title: Investigating neutron transfer in the 9 Be + 197 Au system
arxiv-2104-13689.creator: Malika Kaushik 1, S.K. Pandit 2, V.V. Parkar 2, G. Gupta 3, Swati Thakur 1, V. Nanal 3, H. Krishnamoorthy 4,5, A. Shrivastava 2,4, C.S. Palshetkar 3, K. Mahata 2,4, K. Ramachandran 2, S. Pal 6, R.G. Pillay 1, Pushpendra P. Singh 1
arxiv-2104-13689.description: Abstract In this work n -transfer and incomplete fusion cross sections for 9 Be + 197 Au system are reported over a wide energy range, E c.m. ≈ \approx 29-45 MeV. The experiment was carried out using activation technique and off-line gamma counting. The transfer process is found to be the dominant mode as compared to all other reaction channels.

arxiv-2109-13150.title: Flavour non-universal Pati-Salam unification and neutrino masses
arxiv-2109-13150.creator: Julie Pagès
arxiv-2109-13150.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Julie Pagès. The B anomalies, by their distinctive flavour structure i.e. U ​ ( 2 ) 5 U(2)^{5} , bring a new piece to the long-standing flavour puzzle. The three-site flavour non-universal Pati-Salam (PS) model, which unifies quarks and leptons, provides through the ratios of vacuum expectation values (VEV) acquired at different scales, a combined explanation of the charged and neutral current B anomalies as well as of the mass hierarchies of the Standard Model (SM).

arxiv-2201-01604.title: Detection of extragalactic Ultra-Compact Dwarfs and Globular Clusters using Explainable AI techniques Journal: Astronomy and Computing
arxiv-2201-01604.creator: Mohammad Mohammadi, Jarvin Mutatiina, Teymoor Saifollahi, Kerstin Bunte
arxiv-2201-01604.description: Abstract Compact stellar systems such as Ultra-compact dwarfs (UCDs) and Globular Clusters (GCs) around galaxies are known to be the tracers of the merger events that have been forming these galaxies. Therefore, identifying such systems allows to study galaxies mass assembly, formation and evolution. However, in the lack of spectroscopic information detecting UCDs/GCs using imaging data is very uncertain.

arxiv-2209-12622.title: Parrondo’s paradox for discrete-time quantum walks in momentum space
arxiv-2209-12622.creator: Georg Trautmann, Caspar Groiseau, Sandro Wimberger
arxiv-2209-12622.description: Abstract We investigate the possibility of implementing a sequence of quantum walks whose probability distributions give an overall positive winning probability, while it is negative for the single walks (Parrondo’s paradox). In particular, we have in mind an experimental realisation with a Bose-Einstein condensate in which the walker’s space is momentum space.

arxiv-2510-26484.title: Bayesian Network Fusion of Large Language Models for Sentiment Analysis
arxiv-2510-26484.creator: Rasoul Amirzadeh, Dhananjay Thiruvady, Fatemeh Shiri
arxiv-2510-26484.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) continue to advance, with an increasing number of domain-specific variants tailored for specialised tasks. However, these models often lack transparency and explainability, can be costly to fine-tune, require substantial prompt engineering, yield inconsistent results across domains, and impose significant adverse environmental impact due to their high computational demands.

britannica-1911-multan.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-multan.description: Article 'Multan' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. The District of Multan occupies the lower angle of the Bari Doab, or tract between the Sutlej and the Chenab, with an extension across the Ravi. The population in 1901 was 710,626, showing an increase of 11·7% in the preceding decade, due to the extension of irrigation. The principal crops are wheat, millets, pulse, oil-seeds, cotton and indigo.

pmc-10735366.title: DATA AND INITIAL EVIDENCE: OCCUPATIONAL CHARACTERISTICS AND LATER-LIFE PHYSICAL AND COGNITIVE HEALTH
pmc-10735366.creator: Dawn Carr
pmc-10735366.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Research on aging is often based on evaluations of health and wellbeing once individuals have already reached later life. However, many of the problems observed are based on experiences that occurred during earlier phases of life. Adults spend approximately 1/3 of their time engaged in paid work, and consequently, occupational exposures are likely to play a critical role in shaping age-related changes over time.

pmc-12801032.title: Isolated Osteochondral Autograft Mosaicplasty for In Situ Fixation of Unstable Osteochondritis Dissecans in Skeletally Mature Patients
pmc-12801032.creator: Stephanie O’Brien, Peter SE Davies, Rebecca Rogers, Alistair IW Mayne, Peter Edwards, Jay Ebert, Peter A D’Alessandro
pmc-12801032.description: Osteochondritis dissecans of the adult knee may result in unstable lesions that cause pain and mechanical symptoms. These often require surgery due to the failure of conservative management. Surgical techniques aim to retain the fragment where possible. Mosaicplasty for in situ fixation provides mechanical stability and a biological stimulus without the need for additional hardware.

pmc-12920540.title: Socioeconomic characteristics and the burden of non-communicable diseases: a cross-sectional analysis of Tanzanian households, 2021
pmc-12920540.creator: Winfrida Kaaya, Alphoncina Kagaigai, Alma Damasy, Nathanael Sirili
pmc-12920540.description: IntroductionNon-Communicable Diseases (NCDs) pose a serious global health challenge. The burden of NCDs affects individuals across various demographic categories. Socioeconomic status (SES) has long been recognized as a determinant of health outcomes. Previous research suggests a complex interplay between SES and NCDs, with disparities in prevalence and disease management observed across different socioeconomic strata.
